title: Three Likenesses of the One Redemption
description: A riddle and its three answers: the First Man, the Living Spirit (with his ship), and the Third Ambassador are likened to a great famous man whose property was taken, a wise craftsman in the ship-furnace, and a great man recovering wealth in a foreign country. Three parables show how the same redemptive intention enters the natural in three different modes — descent as father, building as artisan-rescuer, recovery as ambassador — each corresponding to a discrete degree of operation.
